cases.title: a product with orders cannot be silently destroyed
delete the test products (this also removes their R2 pictures)
delete the uploaded picture of the first test product
database: the test picture rows are gone

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from image_entity where entity_category = 'products' and entity_id = $1

cases.title: FINAL: no variant has negative stock

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from product_variants where stock < 0

cases.title: FINAL: every variant's stock equals its ledger total

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from product_variants v where coalesce((select sum(m.delta) from inventory_movements m where m.variant_id = v.variant_id),0) <> coalesce(v.stock,0)

cases.title: FINAL: product stock totals still match their variants

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from products p where p.stock_quantity is distinct from (select coalesce(sum(v.stock),0) from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id) and exists (select 1 from product_variants v where v.product_id = p.product_id)

cases.title: FINAL: the real data is intact (153 products from the migration are still there)

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from products where name not like 'LT %'

cases.title: FINAL: the 83 real orders are untouched

sql.q: select count(*)::int n from orders where customer_id <> all($1::int[]) and customer_id <> $2
